lines.speaker: Messenger
lines.text: David! Jesse, your father, is calling you. He is waiting for you in the courtyard.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I am coming. Let me leave the sheep with their keeper, and I will go to my father.

lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: Go to your father, David. I will keep the flock safe.

characters: Separate Messenger and Keeper instances of the retained challenge-soldier rig, with individual clothing tints and royal equipment hidden; no new model download.
